title: Sign in with two-factor authentication
caption: PF-03, PF-04 AC2. Needs an account with MFA on (Security page).

steps.title: Password
steps.body: Type the address and password, **Sign in**.
steps.expect: Redirect to `/sign-in/mfa` ("Two-factor authentication"); only `__Host-vxp_mfa` and `__Host-vxp_next` are set, no session cookie.

steps.title: Code
steps.body: Type the 6-digit code of the authenticator app, **Verify and sign in**.
steps.expect: Redirect to `next` or `/dashboard`; the challenge cookies are deleted; `platform.account_sessions` has a new family (`audience = 'portal'`).

steps.title: Recovery code instead
steps.body: Choose **Use a recovery code instead** and type one of the ten codes.
steps.expect: Signed in; `platform.account_recovery_codes.used_at` is set for that code; the same code fails the next time.

steps.title: Wrong and expired codes
steps.body: Type a wrong code; wait more than 5 minutes and try again.
steps.expect: Wrong code: message at the field, challenge kept. After 5 wrong codes or 5 minutes: back to `/sign-in?mfa=expired`.

steps.title: Lock-out
steps.expect: "try again in 15 minutes" (wait from `Retry-After`); `accounts.locked_until` set, audit `auth.locked`.
